best_for: Windows users who just installed an SSD or USB drive and want a quick read and write speed test to compare against the box or a forum post.

points.title: Sequential and random tests
points.text: It measures read, write and mixed speeds for large sequential transfers and small random ones, with Peak, Real World and Demo modes.

points.title: Free download, paid Store copy
points.text: The installer and zip are free and the source is MIT licensed. The Microsoft Store versions of each edition are listed at USD 9.99. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Numbers are not comparable everywhere
points.text: Results depend on test size, where the file lands, fragmentation, the controller and the CPU. Results also do not carry over between major CrystalDiskMark versions, and MB/s means one million bytes per second.

points.title: Testing wears the drive a little
points.text: The author warns that benchmarks may shorten the life of an SSD or USB stick. Run it to check a drive, not on a schedule.

points.title: Network drives need a normal launch
points.text: Run as administrator, it hides network drives. Choose No at the UAC prompt to test a network share.

points.title: Wide Windows support
points.text: It runs on Windows XP through 11 and Server 2003 through 2025, for x86, x64 and Arm64; the installer and x64 build skip XP and Server 2003. The Windows listing keeps 7 versions, all machine-wide installers.
